services.desc: To help celebrate our annual O-Tsukimi, Moonviewing Festival, the Garden will be closing early on the following days: As the event approaches each day, there will be partial closures in certain areas, including our Mt. Hood Overlook, Tea Garden, and parts of our Cultural Village. The majority of our landscape will still be available to enjoy an early autumn day in, so we look forward to seeing you here! Your admission ticket includes access to the Garden, the Garden Gift Shop, the Umami Café, and Art Exhibitions. Tickets are non-refundable.
